args.message: module.py now implements solve(data) per the user contract using only the standard library, with no imports. It validates that data has object keys base and patch, deep-clones the inputs so they are never mutated, removes keys whose patch value is null (no-op if absent), merges nested objects recursively, replaces lists wholesale, inserts absent keys as-is, and raises ValueError on JSON type mismatches (booleans and numbers differ). Key order follows base, then patch-only keys. The public tests passed 3/3 on candidate hash e9aa23423b47d1d883cffb441620a04f512ed1513450f2fd9cb3a2d6be38bb68. Only the public suite has run; no user tests were submitted.
